description: This file defines the CustomerReward controller class for the OpenCart admin report extension, handling display, saving settings, and generating customer reward reports.

classes.name: CustomerReward
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer reward reports in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer reward report form page with breadcrumbs and configuration data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the customer reward report settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer reward report list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the customer reward report list.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the customer reward report data as a view, with filtering, pagination, and customer data.
